title: Yellowed Crispy Croatian Meat Kebabs
description: A quick-fix Croatian dish featuring minced garlic and air-fried meat, this recipe is low-carb-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of grassy and glassy-jelly textures adds a unique twist to traditional meat kebabs.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Thread the meat mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place them in the air fryer basket.
Cook the kebabs in the air fryer for 12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
While the kebabs are cooking, combine the bruised lemongrass and dissolved gelatin in a small bowl.
After the kebabs have finished cooking, brush them with the lemongrass and gelatin mixture.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional lemongrass if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
